screen: Round ready and every setup step (pinned footer)
issue: The scroll meets the pinned footer with a hard horizontal cut: on Round ready the invite card's Invite the group button is sliced in half at full contrast just above Tee off on hole 1, and every setup step slices its last row the same way (Pick the game first, Birch Creek's sub line, the Net/Gross/Both segment, Jackson's row, Marcus's tees chips). The fade is there but it is too short to hide text and the content (the button label in Round ready) paints over it, so it reads as a rendering bug, not as 'more below'.
fix: In styles.css give :is(.cta-wrap,.pin-btn)::before z-index: 2 so it paints over the .scroll content, raise its height to 40px and end it solid: background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--canvas) 70%). Do the same in overview.css for .setup > .cta-wrap::before (height 40px, same stop), so a cut row fades out fully before the edge.

issue: The Rabbit game art is see-through: its head and body have no fill, so in dark the card shows through and the rabbit reads as a dark ball with a white outline (only ink and pink fills in rabbit.svg). In light it only works because the card is white.
fix: Add the ball fill #fbf7ec under the head and body paths in src/art/games/rabbit.svg (as the other game files do), so the sticker reads cream in both themes.

screen: Big Game setup, Games step (Field skins rules)
issue: The four skins rule rows (Ties carry, Canadian skins, Validate skins, Birdies win two skins) now wear the card hairline and radius, but their text has zero left padding: every title and description sits on the row's left border and the first letters are cut by the rounded corner.
fix: Remove the override at styles.css:3634 (.big-games .block > .toggle-row.ap-game { padding-left: 0; padding-right: 0 }) so the rows keep .toggle-row.ap-game's 12px 14px, or make them flush divider rows like .side-game .toggle-row.flush (no border, border-top hairline, padding 12px 0 0).

screen: Bets step hero vs Round ready
issue: The same 'what's on the line' summary is a saturated ochre slab on the Bets step ($2 a skin, carryovers) but a pale butter wash on Round ready. The Bets one is the loudest block in setup and is not the thing to tap.
fix: Give .summary-card on the Bets step (SetupStep.jsx line 72) the same pale wash as .ready-card.themed (the game colour's light tint, e.g. var(--butter) or color-mix(in srgb, var(--gt) 25%, var(--card))), keeping the ochre for the dark top bar only.

screen: Bets step: Side games and Side bets add rows
issue: Two add-row styles sit one step apart: Add a side game / Add a side bet are white dashed cards with a square surface tile and a thin ink plus, while Add a course / Add a player are dashed surface cards with a round ochre plus. The n3 note said each side game's add is the round add button; on the Bets step it isn't.
fix: Render the SideGames.jsx add (button.set-row.add-side, div.set-icon) and the side-bet add with the shared .add-row markup (span.add-ci round ochre plus, span.add-lbl) used in PlayersStep.jsx line 130, keeping the sub line.

screen: Handicaps: Players step vs Handicaps step
issue: The same handicaps choice is two different controls: a segmented 'No, play even / Yes' card on the Players step, and a Use handicaps switch on the Handicaps step opened from the overview. One decision should look the same wherever it is made.
fix: Use the Players step's segmented control (No, play even / Yes with its help line) in HandicapsStep in OverviewStep.jsx instead of the Toggle row, or the switch in both.

screen: First tee sheet: the high-five art
issue: The two hands meeting at the top of the high-five are cream discs with a faint grey outline (22% ink), not the ink line every other part has, so in dark they read pale and half see-through and in light they nearly vanish against the white border.
fix: In components/SpotArt.jsx change Hand to stroke var ink (#0a0a0a) at the same width as the buddy outline (about 2.4), or draw a proper fist with the line props, so the hands match the heads.

issue: Ben's buddy is too big for its disc: the ball's left edge and the back of the cap are cut off by the circle, and his pink cap sits on a pink plate with almost no contrast. Every other avatar sits whole inside its disc.
fix: In the avatar renderer (Avatar.jsx / BuddyArt.jsx) scale this buddy (the side-cap drawing) to the same inset as the others so the ball and cap stay inside the plate with the ink outline whole, and pick a plate colour that is not the cap's (mint or lav) for pink caps.

issue: Rows waiting on the game still show full-looking Pick chips (only 72% opacity), and the Handicaps row says 'Pick the game first' next to a filled Change chip, while the rows above use outline Pick chips. Locked looks tappable and the chip styles differ inside one list.
fix: In overview.css drop the .ov-change chip on :disabled rows (or render it as plain mute text at .45 opacity), and give the Handicaps and Playing for rows the same outline chip as .ov-row.todo while the game is unpicked.

issue: The sheet is crammed: each card is a 32px drawing in a 70px empty gutter beside six to eight lines of rules text, and titles wrap leaving the separator dot hanging ('Closest to the pin ·' / '$5 each', 'Calcutta · Auction at the' / 'first tee · 70/30').
fix: In SideGames.jsx put the price on its own sub line instead of 'Name · $5 each' in the title, cut the description to one sentence (the Rules chip has the rest), and size the art to 48px with the column 56px wide.

issue: The sun override for the money strip isn't reaching the screen. play.css says the light strip's amounts take #8f2219 and #0a5440 (7:1 and up), but the shot renders -$4 in #b83226 and +$12 in #0f6b4f on the butter strip: 5.0:1 and 5.5:1, the weakest numbers on a screen read in full sun.
fix: Inspect the computed colour of .money-strip .ms-a.neg in the light look; the :root:not([data-theme="dark"]) rules at play.css:47-48 are losing to .ms-a.neg/.pos at play.css:58-59 (or the light theme sets data-theme dark-agnostic). Simplest: set the tokens on the strip itself, .money-strip { --loss: #8f2219; --win: #0a5440 } in light, and keep the dark media block resetting them.

screen: Every sheet: Round menu sheets, First tee, Add a side game, Start a trip, Add an expense
issue: When a sheet scrolls, its content slides under the sticky title with a hard cut: half a line of text ('its front value.', 'start on.'), the top of a Nobody chip, a sliver of a card edge and a row's icon all sit sliced right under the title. The same hard cut shows on First tee (STROKES half sliced), Add a side game, Start a trip (half a PICK THE TEAMS label, an avatar's chin) and Add an expense; the drag handle also scrolls away with the content.
fix: Give .sheet-head (styles.css:508) a soft fade under it: .sheet-head::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; top:100%; height:16px; background:linear-gradient(var(--sheet-bg), transparent); pointer-events:none } shown only when the sheet body has scrolled (the same scroll-driven fade setup uses), or a hairline once scrolled.

screen: Wolf hole, the wolf and partner rows
issue: In dark the wolf's and partner's score rows are tinted #2e2a1c, a muddy olive brown band (two of them stacked once a partner is picked). It's the colour band the brief calls out, and the Par chip and buttons sit on it at low contrast.
fix: Keep the dark row on var(--card) and mark the team with the Wolf and Partner tags plus a butter edge: box-shadow: var(--hair), inset 0 0 0 1.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ochre) 55%, transparent). Drop the butter wash in dark only.

screen: Wolf hole 1 and 7, pick a partner
issue: Lone wolf 2x has no chip in dark: .pill-btn's background is var(--card), the same as the dark Wolf panel, so it reads as a line of text while Jackson, Marcus and Dev beside it are outlined chips. In light it's a white pill.
fix: In the dark panel rules (play.css:177/186) add .wolf-panel .pill-btn { background: var(--surface) } or give it the partner chips' hairline (box-shadow: var(--hair)) so all four choices look tappable.

screen: Snake and Stableford panels, the game art
issue: The snake and star stickers in the game panels sit inside a rounded-square outlined tile (.bn-art: radius 7px, 2px white outline), a plate behind the drawing, and the snake's head and the star's points cross the frame. At 26px the sticker is also too small to read as a drawing.
fix: styles.css:4208: drop border-radius and outline from .bn-art and size it 32 to 36px so the art's own die-cut border is the only edge; vertically centre it on the two text lines.

issue: The 'Jackson is keeping score' bar stays the light-theme mint slab in dark, the brightest block on the screen, while every other coloured panel in dark became a card with an edge.
fix: styles.css:1348: in dark give .seat-req.keeper-bar background: var(--card); box-shadow: var(--hair), and the mint as a straight top bar or the pencil icon in var(--mint); keep the pill-btn on var(--surface).

issue: The sheet's action button isn't pinned: at first view 'Type a name' is sliced in half by the sheet's bottom edge, and it only shows whole once scrolled. Every other round-menu sheet pins its Save in a footer.
fix: Move the AddPlayer action into the sheet's sticky footer (the same footer slot Bets, Handicaps and Round length use), so it sits whole at the bottom with the fade over it.

issue: The Players card and the Strokes given card touch: about 2px between them where every other card pair in the sheet has 12px, so the two cards read as one glitched block.
fix: handicaps-sheet.css: margin-top: 12px on the Strokes given card (or a gap on the sheet body's flex column).

issue: The Birdie! toast lands on top of the 'Everyone starts at par' hint, and the hint's words show through it ('or + for anything' over the toast in both themes), so neither reads.
fix: ui.jsx toast: an opaque background (var(--ink) light, var(--on-ink) dark at full alpha) and a bottom offset that clears the footer and the hint (bottom: calc(footer height + 16px)), z-index above the scroll content.

issue: The sticky stack (header, money strip, hole line, game panel) holds about 500 of 844px once you scroll, and the Wolf panel before a pick about 660px, leaving one and a half score rows visible between it and Save. Scoring is the one screen used one-handed on the course; the rows are the focal point.
fix: Keep only the header and money strip sticky; let the hole line and the game panel scroll away, or collapse them on scroll into one line (hole, par, worth) the way the Wolf panel folds once picked.

screen: Halfway sheet, Every score so far
issue: The halfway summary shows holes 1 to 7 only; 8 and 9 sit off to the right behind a sideways scroll (a ring clipped at the edge), so the front nine the sheet is about isn't on screen.
fix: Give the Scorecard a compact mode for Halfway: nine 28px columns, smaller rings and boxes (24px), and an OUT column, so the front nine fits 358px without scrolling.

screen: Money strip and dark game panels (first hole, every game), the colour edge
issue: The game colour on the dark panels and money strip is an inset 3px left box-shadow, so it bends round the 20px corners into a crescent; Vegas's pink edge does it in light too. setup-12 replaced the same bent edge with a straight bar on Round ready and results.
fix: play.css:42/44/177/186: replace inset 3px 0 0 with a straight bar, e.g. a ::before 3px wide inside overflow:hidden, or the straight top bar Round ready uses.

screen: Sam's avatar everywhere (setup Players, Hammer, Nassau, results, reward, trip and Cup rows, Big Game)
issue: Sam's avatar plate is the dark teal, so his ink head outline, the beanie's black band and pom merge into it and the face reads as a black blob at 36px; every other buddy sits on a light pastel plate where the ink outline shows. The same buddy fails on every screen it appears: setup Players (pom-pom clipped by the disc, and only his plate gets a grey ring in dark), results and the reward hero, trip standings and team rows, the Cup and Big Game lists.
fix: art-palette: give this buddy a light plate (mint or a teal tint) like the others, or a cream ring between the ink outline and the dark plate.

issue: The gold crown has no die-cut sticker border in any placement (podium, reveal hero, reveal winner row, reward hero, team podium). Crown() renders the file with ArtImage outline={false}, so on the dark card its ink outline melts into the background and the gold shape reads as cut out; it also floats about 6px clear of the avatar's top edge instead of sitting on the hat.
fix: In Podium.jsx Crown(), pass outline (the shared sticker outline) instead of outline={false}; then lower .crowned .crown-art (styles.css ~3708) so its base overlaps the avatar by 3 to 4px, e.g. top: calc(var(--face) * .06).

issue: In dark the podium reads brown and olive: step 2 #3b352c and step 3 #2e2a25 are muddy browns, and step 1 measures #c39d42, a dimmed mustard. Next to the green-black card the block looks like a brown band, the thing the brief flags (Trevor's call 1 asked for warm greys; these read brown).
fix: styles.css ~3729 to 3734: step 2 a neutral grey off the card (e.g. #2f3432) and step 3 one notch lower (#262a29), both with a 1px var(--line) top edge; step 1 the full var(--ochre) #e8b94a rather than the dimmed one.

issue: The podium drops a tied player: Standings show Sam and Jackson both T3 on -$12, but the T3 step holds only Sam. Jackson simply isn't on the podium.
fix: Podium.jsx: build the third step from every player whose rank is 3 (not standings.slice(0, 3)) and stand them side by side as the team podium does (.team-podium face overlap), or show the step with the T3 label and both faces.

issue: Once the count finishes, the reveal scrolls so the last row clears the buttons, which leaves the headline 'Marcus takes it' sliced in half under the sticky header at rest. The moment's main line is the one thing cut off.
fix: Finale.jsx (scroll effect ~line 131): cap the scrollBy so the hero's h1 stays below the header (scroll by min(over, h1.top - header.bottom)), or shrink the settled hero avatar (rv-crowned size) so the four rows and the headline fit at 390x844.

issue: On the share image the art sits on the ochre band in the same ochre: the crown reads as an outline only, the coin-stack game art all but disappears, and the winner buddy has no white sticker border, so the art looks pasted on rather than die-cut stickers. The coin stack is also tiny (about 24px) and floats under the date.
fix: shareImage.js / ResultsArt.jsx: draw each piece with the white sticker outline (a 5 to 6px #fff stroke around the silhouette before the fill), and set the game art at 40px aligned with the course name or drop it from the band.

issue: The saved solo round's hero is a generic Phosphor 'smiley' icon in a teal blob, not brand art, and the score '71 E' is hot pink, which should be kept for the one thing to tap. The finish screen for the same kind of round (Nice round) shows the player's buddy and an ink score, so the two disagree.
fix: RoundDetail.jsx solo branch (~line 230): replace <Icon name="smiley"> with the player's AvatarArt (as Finale's nice screen does) and colour .nice-hero .wa and .nice-par in var(--ink) / var(--body).

issue: Riley's hot-pink glasses sit on a hot-pink #ff4d8b disc, so the frames' outer edge vanishes into the ground and the brand's tap pink becomes a big avatar fill on the podium.
fix: art-palette.js: never pair a buddy wearing pink with the pink ground (pick lav or peach), or give the glasses frame an ink outer stroke in the buddy file.

issue: The flexing ball spot has blurred grey smudges inside both elbows and white fill in the arm crooks between arm and body, so the background doesn't show through; in dark the smudges look dirty.
fix: In the flex spot file (src/art/spots), remove the grey shading inside the biceps and cut the enclosed arm-to-body areas out of the sticker outline so the card shows through.

issue: The waiter-with-tray spot on the ochre reward card keeps white islands between the legs and in the gaps between arms, tray and body, where the ochre should show.
fix: In the tray spot file, cut the leg gap and the arm gaps out of the white sticker fill so only an even border follows the outside silhouette.

issue: For a two-side result the podium labels the losing side 2, but Standings call Sam and Tyler T3. Same result, two different places.
fix: In the standings placeLabel for team games, rank by side (T1 and T2) so the list matches the podium's 1 and 2.

issue: Settle the trip is still one tall card per payment, each with two big buttons (an outline I got it and a Request on Venmo slab), seven of them plus three more cards under Everyone else: about four screens of heavy outlined buttons. The round's Settle up was reworked to one card of hairline rows with the quiet payment-app button and an outline Mark paid, so the two settle screens now look like different apps.
fix: In Trip.jsx (settle rows around line 654, .pay-acts.settle-row-acts) render the same one-card row list Settle up uses: avatar, 'Dev pays you', amount, then a quiet 'Request' app button and an outline 'I got it' on one line, hairlines between rows. Everyone else joins the same card style below its label.

screen: Trip page and Up next, a trip ahead
issue: Nov 12 is said three times: the eyebrow reads 'STARTS THU, NOV 12 · NOV 12 TO 15', the note under the list repeats 'Tees off Thu, Nov 12', and Up next's trip card has 'NOV 12 TO 15' over 'Starts Thu, Nov 12'.
fix: Trip.jsx line ~133: before the trip the eyebrow is just the range with weekdays ('THU TO SUN · NOV 12 TO 15'), since the hero already says '17 days to go'. Up next's trip card: eyebrow 'BANDON BOYS', title 'Starts Thu, Nov 12' with the range in the sub line, or drop the start from one of them.

screen: Trip page before it starts, Standings
issue: Before any round the Standings view lists all eight players in full rows with an en dash for place and an en dash for money: a table of sixteen dashes that says nothing, taking a screen and a half.
fix: Until a round finishes, render Who's going as a compact face row (the avatar stack with names, or a two-column name grid) instead of the standings rows, and drop the place and money columns. The note under it already starts 'Who's going'.

screen: Trip page, the road trip scene
issue: The road trip scene runs edge to edge: its mint horizon band runs off both sides of the screen, so the die-cut white border is cut at the viewport edges on the left and right, and the drawing ignores the page's 16px gutter. It reads as a cropped photo strip rather than a sticker sitting on the page.
fix: Either end the mint band inside the artboard with its own white outline (redraw the scene's ground as a finite pill in the scene file) or inset it: .trip-screen .trip-scene { margin: 4px 16px 10px; } with the scene scaled to fit, so the border runs all the way round.

screen: Up next, More ways to play: Big Game art
issue: In the Big Game crowd sticker the back-row purple visor and red cap are flat fills with no ink line on their top edges, while every other hat in the crowd (and every buddy hat elsewhere) has the ink outline.
fix: In the crowd spot's drawing file, add the ink stroke round the purple visor and the red cap like the bucket hat and flat cap beside them.

screen: Trip page and Cup trip: Bring the group in, Leaving early?, Done playing?
issue: Pink is used as decoration: the pink tinted icon discs on Bring the group in (link), Leaving early? and Done playing? (.trip-act-ic), while the action on those cards is ink. In the dark they turn into plum discs. Pink should be only on the one thing to tap.
fix: Make .trip-act-ic the neutral disc the info line's suitcase uses (var(--surface) with an ink icon), both themes.

issue: The split list ticks everyone with a hot pink filled check, so the sheet ends in a column of nine pink discs; the sheet's real action, Add the expense, is grey below them.
fix: In TripExpenses.jsx give the ticked split row the ink check (the same black selected state as the Who paid chips, cream in the dark), keeping pink off the list.

screen: Trip and Cup trip, Expenses: the Dinner row
issue: The Dinner row's meta wraps so the second line starts with a dot: 'Jackson paid · Split 4 ways' then '· Mon, Oct 26'. The date was kept whole (trips-30) but the separator now leads the line.
fix: In the expense row put a non-breaking space before each ' · ' (as tab-8 did on the Tab) or include the dot in the .nowrap span with the date, so a wrap carries the dot with the word before it.

issue: Walls of grey explainer text everywhere on the trip: five lines under Standings ('Finished rounds on this phone...'), two paragraphs (six lines) under Everyone, all in, six lines at the foot of Settle the trip, six lines under the schedule in Start a trip, five or six under a template, and a five-line centred paragraph in the Matches empty state. It crowds the focal numbers and fights the breathing-room direction.
fix: Cut each to one short line (or none) and move the rest into the existing 'How this trip works +' fold or the rules sheet; the Matches empty state keeps one sentence under the flag.

issue: With no groups the preview is a full blank page with one line of text, and Print the pairings stays enabled, so it offers to print an empty sheet.
fix: When there are no groups, replace the page preview with the empty state (a spot, the one line, and a 'Plan the trip's rounds' button) and hide or disable Print the pairings.

screen: Start a trip Teams, Cup score tiles, Cup view team tiles (dark)
issue: In the dark the team columns and the Cup score tiles are solid navy and maroon slabs; the maroon reads brown-red and both are heavy on the dark canvas next to the calm cards.
fix: Use a low wash in the dark, e.g. color-mix(in srgb, var(--team-red) 16%, var(--card)), and let the team dot carry the colour.

screen: Big Game setup, Games step (Field skins)
issue: Copy typo on the skins stake label: "Each player in puts in".
fix: BigGameSetup.jsx:412: change the field-label to "Each player puts in" (or "Each player in skins puts in").

issue: Every picked player is a pink-tinted card with a 2px pink ring and a pink check, so with nine picked the step is a wall of pink. Round setup's Who's in marks a pick with an ink ring and an ink check, and pink is meant only for the one thing to tap.
fix: Give .player-pick.on in Big Game the round setup's picked style: white card, inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ink) (cream in dark), ink check disc; drop the --pick-tint background and --pink-fill ring from .list-item.pick.on for this list (styles.css:797) or share the round's player-row component.

issue: Each picked player shows all nine tee chips in three rows (81 chips for nine players), pushing the list to many screens. Round setup shows one "Black tees" chip that opens the choice, and the round's Handicaps sheet was cut from 36 chips to 8 for the same reason.
fix: In BigGameSetup.jsx (tee-chips, line ~281) replace the radiogroup with the round setup's single tee chip (dot, tee name, caret) that opens the tee picker sheet; keep Course handicap beside it on one row.

issue: The Big Game's player rows are name and HCP only, no Ball buddy. Round setup's Who's in, the Big Game board, the draft and the Cup leaderboard all lead each person with their buddy, so the same people look different here.
fix: Add the AvatarArt (size sm) at the start of each .player-pick row, as in round setup's player rows.

issue: Six step chips overflow 390px: the row is cut hard at the screen edge mid-word ("B" of Bets on Players, "Bets" sliced on Course, a lone "y" of Day on Groups) with no fade. Round setup's four chips fit.
fix: On the Steps row in Big Game setup add a mask-image edge fade (linear-gradient to transparent over 24px on the overflowing side) plus scroll-padding-inline:16px, or shorten to fit (Day, Course, Players, Groups, Games, Bets at 13px with 10px gaps) so nothing is sliced.

issue: Scrolled content is cut by a hard edge right under the sticky question ("HCP 24.3" and tee chips sliced in half, a toggle cut through). Round setup's steps got a soft scroll fade under the title (setup-8); Big Game's didn't.
fix: Apply the round setup's scroll-driven top fade class to the Big Game step scroller (the same fade used under setup's step-q), shown only while scrolled.

issue: Under the summary sit two chips "G1 · 0" and "G2 · 0" with heavy 1.5 to 2px ink (cream in dark) rings: the label is cryptic (it means holes in) and the rings are the heaviest thing on the screen, louder than the headline.
fix: styles.css:1997-1998: make .big-dots .trip-day.now a hairline like the others (inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line)); label them "Group 1 · thru 0", or hide BigDots until any group has a hole in.

issue: Each match's pencil edit chip is about 34 by 26px, well under a 44px hit area, and filled beige while the header's Edit is an outline button.
fix: On the match card's edit button set min-width:44px; min-height:44px (keep the 26px visual chip inside with a transparent hit pad) and match the header button's hairline outline style.

issue: The coinflip sticker's white border wraps each tiny motion tick separately, so in dark two white tabs stick out of the coin like ears; the coin itself is a blank pink oval that reads as a pill or an egg more than a coin.
fix: In spots/coinflip.svg merge the motion ticks into the main sticker outline (one die-cut path around coin plus ticks) or drop the ticks' own white stroke; give the coin face a mark (a star or a C) so it reads as a coin.

issue: Before a game is picked the footer shows two disabled controls: a disabled Pick a game button and a faded Schedule for later link that reads as broken (the overview already hides it until there's a game).
fix: In screens/newround/GameStep.jsx line 93 render the Schedule for later link only when game is set, as OverviewStep.jsx does with laterOk.

issue: '4–8 players · 2 v 2 up to 4 v 4' wraps leaving 'v 4' alone on the second line in the Best ball and Shamble tiles.
fix: Join the format with non-breaking spaces ('2\u00a0v\u00a02 up to 4\u00a0v\u00a04') in the tile sub line, or text-wrap: balance on the tile sub.

issue: Game art sizes jump around: the list tiles draw at about 70px while the grid tiles draw at about 36px (Match play, Sixes, Vegas look like icons), and in the list the Banker figure fills far less of its slot than Wolf, Nassau and Skins.
fix: Give the grid tile art a 48px box (the .tile art class) and trim Banker's viewBox in src/art/games/banker.svg so the figure fills its box like the others.

screen: Game step: Vegas and Shamble art
issue: The thin motion lines under the Vegas dice and beside the Shamble ball turn into white smudges in dark: the sticker border swallows the short strokes.
fix: Merge the speed lines into one shape or thicken them to the main line weight in vegas.svg and shamble.svg so the die-cut border follows them cleanly.

screen: Overview and Look it over values
issue: Every row value is in the serif display face at 18px ('Skins', 'Logan River GC', 'Off'), six of them stacked under a serif title, and long Players values wrap leaving 'and Dev' / 'and Cody' alone. 'Not set yet' is in the sans, so the type switches row to row.
fix: Set .ov-value to the body face at 17px weight 600 (keep the serif for the title), and add text-wrap: balance so player lists break evenly.

screen: Course step and Plan a round: Courses near me
issue: The Courses near me pill has a pink navigation arrow (pink on a secondary control) and is about 34px tall.
fix: In NearYou.jsx drop fill on the navigation-arrow icon and colour it var(--ink) or var(--body); give .near-btn min-height: 44px.

issue: The filled favourite star is a dark mustard that reads brown on white in light, while in dark it is a clear yellow.
fix: Use var(--ochre) (#e8b94a) with a hairline ink stroke for the filled star in light, matching the dark one.

screen: Play for step and its reward chips
issue: The step titled 'What are you playing for?' repeats itself with a PLAY FOR eyebrow inside the card, and the reward chips (Lunch, A drink, Custom) are about 30px tall.
fix: In OverviewStep.jsx PlayForStep pass label={false} to PlayForPicker (as PlayForSheet does), and give .pf-chips buttons min-height: 44px.

issue: Each is one small card under the title and then about 550px of empty canvas above Done, which reads unfinished rather than calm.
fix: Put a centred spot (coinflip for Play for, scale or flag for Handicaps) at 120px under the card, or open both as a sheet sized to its content.

screen: Players step for Wolf with two
issue: The step shows scrolled: Trevor's picked card is cut under 'Wolf takes exactly 4.' and the count line ('Players · 2 picked') the disabled 'Add 2 more players' refers to is out of view.
fix: Keep the scroll position when a row is picked (no scrollIntoView on pick in PlayersStep.jsx), or keep the count line sticky under the step sub.

screen: Players, Course and Game selected cards
issue: A picked card is a 2px ink frame (cream in dark), so four picked players stack four heavy black boxes; it fights the hairline direction and the black Next button for weight.
fix: Mark the picked state with the check disc plus a 1.5px ink hairline (or a tinted card) in the .pick-row.on rule, not a 2px frame.

issue: The sub line wraps '$2' and 'default bet' onto separate lines ('· $2' / 'default bet · $1–$10').
fix: Join '$2 default bet' with non-breaking spaces where the Run it back sub line is built.

issue: 'Going on a golf trip? Start a trip' is all one mute line with no link styling, while the Game step's 'More than one group? Set up a Big Game' underlines its link in ink.
fix: In Trips.jsx StartTripLink wrap 'Start a trip' in <u> (as GameStep.jsx line 84 does) so the two quiet links match.

issue: The Front 9 / Back 9 / Total tiles are white on cream with no hairline, the only cards on the screen without one.
fix: Add box-shadow: var(--hair) to the Nassau strip tiles in play.css.

screen: Scrolled steps: smeared controls under the top fade
issue: Under the 16px top fade a dark fill turns into a grey gradient smudge: the Set it up again button, the Hole 1 and 18 segment thumbs look like blurred blobs rather than content passing under the title.
fix: Lengthen the .setup > .scroll::before fade to 24px and add a hairline under the title block once scrolled (as the header already does), so cut controls read as cut, not smeared.

screen: Plan a round from Schedule for later: When
issue: The day strip starts with a sliced chip and a stray '3' at its left edge (no fade on that side), and inside the same card 'Tee time optional' is a sentence-case label while DAY and HOLES are tracked eyebrows.
fix: Scroll the strip so today's chip is first with the left fade applied, and make 'Tee time' an eyebrow (with 'optional' in the field's placeholder).

screen: Plan a round from Schedule for later: course
issue: 'The course is picked below. Change it if you need to.' then a search field, then the picked course under 'Your course': the picked course sits under the field that replaces it.
fix: Show Your course first with a Change link that reveals the search, and drop the helper line.

issue: Mid-entrance the outgoing Look it over (Banker, Logan River GC, Create round) shows through the incoming step's half-transparent cards, so two screens' text overlap for a moment.
fix: In Stage.jsx animate the incoming step's position, not its cards' opacity, or fade the outgoing screen out before the new one's cards reach full opacity.

issue: The four-buddy crew's die-cut fills the gaps between heads, so there is a white island under Trevor's black brim between his cap and the flat cap; in dark the crew reads as one white blob rather than four heads touching.
fix: In the crowd sticker (SpotArt.jsx Crowd, ArtFile sticker radius) cut the border per figure or reduce the merge radius so the canvas shows between heads where they don't overlap.

screen: Scorecard sheet, Halfway table and results scorecard: stroke dots
issue: The stroke dots sit on the boundary between two columns (Dev's at x=130, 166, 202 are on the right edges of holes 1 to 3), and on Halfway they land on the corners of the score rings and boxes, so it's unclear which hole gets the stroke. On the results scorecard the dot sits on the top-right corner of the square and ring marks, so they look nicked.
fix: scorecard.css: position the dot inside its own cell, top: 4px; right: 4px, and inset it from the ring (or put it under the number).

issue: In light the current hole is a solid pink header cell with a pink wash down the column; in dark the same column is neutral (scorecard.css:19-20). Pink on a display cell competes with the one thing to tap, and the two themes disagree.
fix: Apply td.cur { background: var(--surface) } in light too, and make the hole header cell an ink fill with on-ink text instead of pink.

screen: Snake, Hammer, Wolf, Banker, Skins scoring
issue: The money strip and the game panel use different colours on the same screen: Snake has a peach strip over a lavender panel, Hammer pink over lavender, Wolf and Skins butter over lavender, Banker butter over ochre. Two competing bands; only Stableford matches. (The Hammer strip's pink itself is Trevor's call; this is about the pair matching.)
fix: Have the panel take the round's game theme (var(--gt) / --gt-soft) like the strip does, so each screen has one game colour, or keep the strip a neutral card.

screen: Segmented controls across sheets and the trip view switch
issue: Segmented controls differ by sheet: 'From hole 3 on / Whole round' and '9 holes / 18 holes' are heavy 18px display, 'Per skin / Pot', 'Net / Gross / Both', 'Money / Points / A reward' and 'Nobody / Split / Playoff' are regular body weight. They also differ in fill: the trip view switch and Print are a white hairline pill with an ink selected tab, while the sheets' controls (Money / Team points, Equally / By amount) sit on a cream fill.
fix: One .seg type everywhere: body face, 600, 16px for the selected and unselected labels.

screen: Round menu, Add a player, A player left, Banker bets
issue: Section labels outside cards mix two styles across the scoring sheets: caps eyebrows (THIS HOLE, GAMES AND BETS, HOW THEY PLAY, STARTS ON HOLE, WHO LEFT, STEP 1 OF 2) beside sentence-case labels (Tees, Players, Hole by hole, Every score so far, Name, in the same Add a player sheet). The kept rule is sentence case outside cards, eyebrows inside them.
fix: Make the out-of-card labels in the round menu, Add a player, A player left and the Banker step the sentence-case section label the Handicaps and Money sheets use.

issue: The end-round ask is titled in the serif display face while every other sheet over scoring is the heavy body face (the kept 'play in the sun' rule).
fix: In the shared ask dialog, use the .sheet-title face when it opens over Play (or pass the play look through), so End this round? matches Round, Bets and Fix hole.

screen: Short sheets: Round length, Course and tee, Side games, Play for, Fix hole, Big Game side bet
issue: On these short sheets nothing scrolls, yet the footer fade still paints over controls: the selected '18 holes' segment fades to grey at its bottom, the 'Send this fix' toggle card and the dashed 'Add a side game' card lose their bottom edge, and the last helper line on Fix hole is dimmed. Same on the Big Game side bet sheet: the fade washes the lower half of the How much field.
fix: Show the sheet footer fade only when the body overflows (the scroll-driven fade the setup steps use); keep the always-on fallback off sheets whose content fits.

issue: On the off toggles the white knob sits over the track's 1.5px edge on its left, so the ring looks bitten.
fix: styles.css:602: inset the knob to top/left 5px with the ring, or draw the edge as an outline outside the track (outline: 1.5px solid var(--mute); outline-offset: -1.5px) so the knob clears it.

issue: The placeholder 'e.g. Sam' is 24px heavy display, so it reads as a name already typed.
fix: styles.css .name-input::placeholder { font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; color: var(--mute) } (keep the typed value big).

screen: Add a player, starts on hole grid
issue: The hole grid's six tiles end about 40px short of the right edge, so it doesn't line up with the name field and the segmented control above it.
fix: grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr) across the full content width (or repeat(auto-fill, minmax(44px, 1fr))).

issue: In dark the overlapping avatars have no ring between them, so the lavender, mint, ochre and peach discs run into one blob; in light each has a cream separating ring.
fix: Give the stacked avatars box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--card) in dark too (the card colour, not the canvas).

issue: The megaphone buddy's three sound strokes sit outside its die-cut border; on the dark card they nearly vanish, and the megaphone's tip sits about 3px from the card's top edge.
fix: In the art file, pull the sound lines inside the sticker silhouette so the white border wraps them; give the art slot 8px top and bottom padding and centre it on the text.

issue: In dark the A badge is the light-theme deep teal on near-black, so the tile all but disappears while the coral B pops.
fix: Dark .side-tag.a: background var(--mint), color var(--teal) (or teal-soft), so A and B carry equal weight.

issue: The rows are grouped under 'A Trevor & Jackson' and 'B Marcus & Dev', and each name still wears its own A or B tag: the letter appears three times per side.
fix: HoleScores.jsx ~line 106: skip the per-row side-tag when the rows are grouped by side (Vegas).

issue: 'Marcus & Dev take 11 points · $11 each' sits on one line with 'All square', which reads as a contradiction (one is this hole, the other the match).
fix: Label them: 'This hole: Marcus & Dev +11 · $11 each' and 'Match: all square', or put the match standing on its own line.

issue: 'No strokes here' keeps the pink stroke dot, so the dot that means a stroke shows on the one hole with none.
fix: Render the dot only when someone gets a stroke on the hole; 'No strokes here' in mute with no dot.

issue: A tapped Birdie fills pink while a tapped Bogey or Dbl fills ink. Pink is meant for the one thing to tap (Save), and the scorecard already moved birdies to ink rings.
fix: Fill every selected score chip ink (on-ink text); let the birdie critter pop be the celebration.

screen: Wolf, Snake, Vegas, Stableford, the side bets prompt
issue: 'Any side bets this round?' and 'Closest to the pin?' lead with a pink icon, a second pink on a secondary prompt.
fix: Icon colour var(--icon) or teal, like the round menu's icons.

issue: The rules list uses pink bullets: decorative pink on a reading sheet.
fix: rules-content: li::marker { color: var(--mute) } (or ink).

issue: 'Stroke index (HCP)' wraps onto two lines beside the stepper, leaving '(HCP)' alone on the second line above the hint.
fix: Label it 'HCP' with the hint 'Stroke index. 1 is the hardest hole', or let the label take a min-width and shrink the stepper to 40px buttons.

screen: Pad, Fix hole, Add a player steppers
issue: Steppers pair a pale beige minus with a solid ink plus, so the enabled minus on Fix hole's Par looks almost as quiet as the disabled minus under it, and plus reads as the primary action.
fix: One stepper style: both buttons the same weight (outline or surface), disabled at .4 opacity.

issue: Each player row is about 100px tall: the name top left, 'Gets 3 strokes' 40px below it on the far side of the tees chip, and the handicap chip stacked under the tees chip. Strokes and name read as separate rows.
fix: Put 'Gets 3 strokes' directly under the name and the tees and handicap chips side by side on the right, one 64px row a player.

issue: One sheet, three label styles: 'Value per skin' is an 18px heavy title inside its card, PAYOUT and SCORES are caps eyebrows inside theirs, and the skin example sits outside its card while the payout and scores helpers sit inside.
fix: Make 'Value per skin' the card's eyebrow like PAYOUT, and move 'Win a skin: up $6...' inside the card under the amount.

issue: The bet cards say 'Gets 6 strokes on the round' and 'Gets 13 strokes on the round', while every other game shows the strokes on this hole ('Gets 1 stroke'). On the bet step the hole's stroke is what matters.
fix: Show the hole's strokes ('Gets 1 stroke here', or nothing) in the Banker bet cards.

issue: The eyebrow reads 'STEP 1 OF 2: BETS & DOUBLES'; the app's copy says 'and', not an ampersand.
fix: 'Step 1 of 2: bets and doubles'.

issue: The lede's example says 'a $5 bet is worth 5 pts' on a round played for $2 a skin.
fix: Use the round's own bet in the example ('$2 a skin becomes 2 pts').

issue: The same numbers change face between screens: the Now card's 'Worth 1 skin · $6' is serif while the scoring panel's '1 skin · $6' is the sans, and the Halfway skins and amounts are serif while the money strip above them is the sans numerals (play-54 meant to give Halfway the strip's numerals).
fix: Use var(--play-num) for the amounts on the Halfway sheet and the Now card, or decide serif for both moments and the panel.

issue: The keeper bar sits flush under the progress line with no gap, while the money strip sits 18px under it on the keeper's phone.
fix: margin-top: 12px on .seat-req.keeper-bar (or the same offset as .money-strip).

issue: Uneven section gaps: about 45px between the summary card and 'Hole by hole' on the Money sheet and about 80px between the money card and 'Every score so far' on Halfway, against 12 to 24px everywhere else.
fix: One section gap (24px) above in-sheet section labels.

issue: The lede and the empty state say the same thing twice ('Bets between two players...' then 'Two players can add their own match...'), stacking three lines of explanation above the one action.
fix: Drop the empty state's paragraph and keep a single line of examples in the Add a side bet card's sub line.

issue: 'Get the link' carries the broadcast icon (the Live mark), not a link icon, and the sheet says 'follow along live from a link' three times (lede, card, footnote).
fix: Use the link icon on Get the link; cut the card's 'Follow the money live. No download.' or the footnote's first clause.

screen: Course and tee, Fix hole cards
issue: Cards in Course and tee and Fix hole have no hairline, while the cards in Bets, Handicaps and Play for do, so sheets from the same menu draw cards two ways.
fix: Give the sheet cards in FixHole and Course and tee the same var(--hair) border as the Bets cards.

issue: On the team podium Riley's disc covers about a third of Trevor's (his cap brim is cut off) and the two crowns crowd each other; in dark Tyler has no ring while his partner has a grey one and the winners a cream one.
fix: Podium.jsx / finale.css: reduce the .team-podium face overlap (negative margin about -14px to -6px) or size 52 to 46, and give every podium avatar the same ring in dark.

issue: The double-or-worse mark's outer ring (box-shadow spread 5px) runs into its neighbours: in the key the sample box touches 'double or worse', in Cody's row adjacent doubles touch each other, and Marcus's first-hole double nearly meets '+16 net +11'. 'gets a stroke' then wraps alone to a second key line.
fix: styles.css ~908: shrink the dbl rings (0 0 0 1.5px, 0 0 0 3px card, 0 0 0 4px) or the mark to 26px; give .sc-legend .sc-key containing .dbl margin-left 4px and gap 10px.

issue: On the same screen you're 'You' in Who pays who and Standings but 'Trevor' in the scorecard's row.
fix: Scorecard.jsx: label the viewer's row 'You' (or 'Trevor (you)') to match the rest of the results.

issue: The react and comment buttons on each payment row are about 48 by 36px, under the 44px tap height, and sit close together.
fix: Give the row's react/comment buttons min-height: 44px (keep the visual chip 36px with a larger hit area via padding or ::before).

issue: The reward headline breaks mid-sentence: 'Sam wins. Loser / buys lunch'. Also this hero puts the avatar above the WINNER eyebrow while every other results hero starts with the eyebrow.
fix: In the reward hero render the two sentences as separate lines ('Sam wins.' then 'Loser buys lunch'), and put the eyebrow first as in the other heroes (or the avatar first everywhere).

issue: The reward card stays a solid ochre slab in dark mode, the loudest surface on the page and brighter than the hero; it fights the calm dark palette.
fix: In dark, make the reward card the dark card with a 4px ochre top bar (as the results hero does) and keep Mark it done as the cream button.

issue: Under Who pays who a tiny handshake glyph in a grey disc repeats the hero's handshake right above it; and with no marks on the card the scorecard ends in an empty band where the key would be.
fix: Drop the icon from the nobody-owes line (plain body text under the heading); hide .sc-legend (and its padding) when there are no marks.

issue: 'How was Birdie Bank today?' shows on the Share screen and again on the results right after it, in the same finish flow.
fix: Show the feedback card once per round (dismiss it on the results once it has been shown on Share).

issue: Mark paid's outline is a heavier khaki (#d3cbb4, 1.5px) in light, not the #e4ddcd 1px hairline used by Edit scores and the app's other outline buttons; and the '0 of 3 paid' note and 'Where it comes from' heading start 4px right of the title, lede and card edge.
fix: Pay.jsx / its CSS: outline buttons use var(--line-strong) like .btn.ghost; align the note and section heading to the 16px gutter (padding-left 0).

issue: In the Skins won card the player's name is the small grey label and the hole list is the bold line, so the hierarchy is upside down (you scan for who, not H3, H6).
fix: Swap the weights: name in 600 ink, hole list in the body or mute colour at 14px.

issue: The crown on the winner row's small avatar reaches within 2px of the gold card border, and in dark the gold '1' disc wears the dark hairline ring meant for the plain discs, so it looks outlined.
fix: finale.css: add 6px top padding to the first .reveal-row (or seat .rv-row-crown lower); skip the dark ring on the first place disc.

issue: The card sits at the top with about 300px of empty canvas before the buttons, so the focal point is off-centre; the header says 'Your card' and the second button says 'See your card', which reads like the same thing.
fix: Centre the nice card in the space above the buttons (margin-block: auto), and title the screen 'Nice round' or rename the button 'Scorecard'.

issue: The sub line wraps to leave 'and 6 pars.' alone on its second line.
fix: text-wrap: balance on .winner-hero .ws.

issue: Mark paid under Everyone else is a filled cream chip; on the round's Settle up Mark paid is the outline button (play-72), so the same action has two looks.
fix: Use the outline button style (the .btn-outline used by Settle up's Mark paid) for the trip's Mark paid chips.

issue: The WHOLE TRIP eyebrow is grey, while every other eyebrow on the trip (DAY 6 OF 8, STARTS THU) and Up next is teal.
fix: Trip.jsx line ~622: give the settle eyebrow the same class as the trip hero's (className="eyebrow pink", which renders teal).

screen: Trip page before it starts, Standings
issue: In the empty standings the place dash (left) is thin, grey and sits higher than the money dash (right), which is darker and heavier, so each row has two different dashes.
fix: Give the empty place and money cells the same style (.trip-place and .trip-amt empty state both var(--mute), same size and baseline), or hide the place cell until there is a place.

issue: 'It all adds up' ends a line and 'to $0.' sits alone on the next, a widow under the Everyone, all in table.
fix: text-wrap: pretty on the trip's notes (.trip-note and the expense footnotes).

screen: Trip, Standings vs Games vs Everyone, all in
issue: The same money is styled three ways: Standings amounts are the big serif, the Games and Everyone, all in tables the sans; You is pink in Standings and Everyone, all in but plain ink in the Games table; the Games TRIP column (the total) has the same weight as the per-game columns.
fix: In the Games table give the You row the same name treatment as the other two views and set the TRIP column to weight 700 so the total reads as the total.

issue: Every row has a '1 of 3 rounds' sub line except You, so the You row's name floats alone and the rows lose their rhythm.
fix: Give You the same sub line ('3 of 3 rounds').

screen: Trip and Cup trip, Rounds view
issue: The gap from the view switch to the Played heading is about 50px, against about 20px from the switch to the first card on Standings, Games and Expenses, so the content jumps when you switch views.
fix: Give the first section label in a trip view the same top margin as the cards (.trip-view > .sec-label:first-child { margin-top: 20px }).

issue: The Played round rows have no caret, while the Heading home rows and Up next's rows do, so it isn't clear a played round opens.
fix: Add the caret-right at the row's end (before or instead of the amount column's trailing space), as on the Heading home rows.

issue: 'How this trip works +' uses a trailing plus as its disclosure, where Up next's More fold uses a caret-down, and it floats in large uneven gaps (about 45px above the hairline, 60px below, then Delete the trip).
fix: Use the caret-down fold row from Up next's More (whole row tappable, 44px), and even 24px gaps around the hairline.

issue: The ochre dot of the corner decoration sits about 5px from the end of 'Oct 21 to 28 · Bandon, OR · 3 rounds'; a longer place name will run under it.
fix: In the trip share image renderer cap the meta line's width (about 70% of the card) or move the dot up into the pink quarter circle.

issue: 'Marcus leads' is set in the heavy grotesque while the trip page and the round results image (play-21) use the serif in the new look, so the trip image doesn't follow the look.
fix: Have the trip standings image take the look's faces like the results image (Fraunces for the headline, Figtree for the rest in the new look).

issue: The trip card has a dismiss × and a caret › side by side at its top right, two small controls 40px apart; the line between the card's two rows is a 3px cream band, not the hairline used elsewhere.
fix: Drop the caret (the whole row already opens the trip) or move dismiss into the card's ⋯; make the row divider a 1px var(--line).

issue: The countdown bar says '04d 15h 00m' to Saturday's Nassau while the Upcoming card right under it says 'SATURDAY, 5 DAYS', two different counts for the same tee time.
fix: Make the Upcoming eyebrow use the same day count as the countdown (floor, '4 days'), or drop the count from the eyebrow since the bar shows it.

issue: All four templates are titled 'Ryder Cup weekend' and differ only in the small sub line, and the number badges are a blue and pink diagonal split that turns navy and maroon in the dark, muddy at that size.
fix: Title each by its size ('8 players, 2 days') with 'Ryder Cup' once in the section label, and give the badge one flat fill (the card's surface with an ink number).

issue: The empty radio rings are nearly invisible: a cream ring on the cream card in light, a dark grey ring on the dark card.
fix: Ring border 1.5px var(--mute) (or var(--line-strong)) for the unselected radio in the template list.

issue: The 'Captains' draft | By handicap | By flights' control has unequal segments and 'Captains' draft' runs to within about 8px of the control's left edge.
fix: flex: 1 on each segment with a 15px label, or shorten to 'Draft'.

issue: The team column headers read '4 · hcp 57.4': lowercase 'hcp' where the rest of the app writes HCP, and a summed handicap that means little.
fix: 'HCP 14.4 avg' (or 'HCP 57.4 total'), uppercase HCP.

issue: '+ Add an afternoon session' has its own short underline under the plus icon, separate from the text's underline.
fix: Underline only the label: wrap it in a span and move the text-decoration from .link-btn onto that span.

issue: The dashed Add a day tile is inset about 16px on each side from the Day card above it, so the two edges don't line up.
fix: TripMode.jsx .add-row in the schedule: margin-left/right 0 so it spans the Day card's width.

issue: Handicaps at offers nine percentage chips that wrap five and four, a heavy block for a setting most groups leave alone.
fix: Show 100%, 90%, 85% and 80% plus 'Other' that opens the rest, or a stepper in 5% steps.

issue: Two lead texts stack before the field ('The template is for 8: you and 7 friends. You have 1 so far.' with an icon, then 'Pick who's coming, or skip it...').
fix: One line: 'For 8: pick 7 friends, or skip it. Anyone who plays a trip round joins.'

issue: Each player is its own filled card (eight cards with gaps), where other people lists (Add an expense's split list, standings, Settle up) are one card with hairline rows.
fix: Render the players as one .block with hairline rows.

issue: 'Untick everyone' sits alone at the right under the list with a large gap above and below it.
fix: Move it into the 'Split it' label row (label left, link right) so it's next to what it changes.

screen: Big Game setup, Players step (tee chip)
issue: In light the selected "Black" tee chip is an ink chip, so its black tee dot vanishes into it (zoom: only a faint disc).
fix: styles.css:280: give .tee-chip.active .tee-dot a 1.5px var(--on-ink) ring (box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--on-ink)).

screen: Big Game setup, Players step (handicap chip)
issue: The Course handicap chip has a pink-tinted fill and pink border. The round's handicap chip was moved to a hairline, not pink (play-58), so the two setups differ.
fix: styles.css:4267 .player-pick.on .pick-extra .hc-chip: use var(--card) with a 1px var(--line) border, matching the round's HCP chip.

issue: The Name label inside the first card is sentence case, while DAY and HOLES in the cards under it are caps eyebrows, so one screen mixes both label styles inside cards.
fix: Make Name an eyebrow (NAME) like DAY and HOLES, or move the Name field out of a card as on Start a trip.

screen: Big Game setup and board, title
issue: The setup header says "The Big Game" and the board header says "Big Game" (the game's name); the same thing reads two ways.
fix: Use one: "The Big Game" for the setup header only when it's new, and the game's own name everywhere after; or both "The Big Game".

issue: "Balance by handicap" is a solid ink pill, the same look as a selected chip, so it reads as an on state rather than a button to re-deal.
fix: Make it an outline pill-btn with an icon (arrows-clockwise) like the app's other secondary actions.

screen: Big Game setup, Games and Groups
issue: Who's in for skins is nine solid ink chips, and each group repeats its names as a second row of Keeps score chips. The blocks of black chips are the heaviest thing on these steps.
fix: Use the light picked chip (hairline, ink check) for multi-select Who's in; keep solid ink for single choices like Keeps score.

issue: The empty Bets step has one helper paragraph above the add tile and another below it, and no art; 60% of the screen is empty.
fix: Merge into one short line under the add tile ("Optional. Any two players, a match or per hole. Add more later from the game's page.").

screen: Big Game board, before tee off
issue: The headline says "Under way" while both groups say Not teed off, and the board is nine rows of en dashes.
fix: BigGame.jsx:91: fall back to "Groups are out" or "Waiting on the first hole" while no group has a hole in, and show a one-line empty note in place of the dash-only board.

issue: "No skins yet" is followed by "0 skins so far across every group, from a $90 pot": two lines saying nothing has happened.
fix: Hide the 0-skins summary line while no hole is decided; keep the pot and rule in the empty note.

issue: The sub line under Red leads 2 to 1 wraps with "on Blue" alone on the second line.
fix: text-wrap: balance on the cup score sub line, or keep "You're on Blue" together with non-breaking spaces.

issue: Ties show the same bare rank on five or six rows in a row (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 6), which reads like a numbering bug.
fix: Prefix shared places with T (T1, T6) in the rank column.

issue: The Captains' draft card has a 2px ink ring (cream in dark), unlike every other card's hairline, so it reads as a focused or selected state.
fix: styles.css:2900 .tm-draft-card: use the card hairline and let a quiet Start chip or the chevron carry the action.

issue: The heading "Start the draft" and the button under it say the same words, and the button floats mid-screen instead of pinned like the app's other single actions.
fix: Retitle the heading ("Ready to draft?") and move the button into the pinned cta-wrap at the bottom.

issue: Link and Pick here are about 40px tall, under 44.
fix: Give the captains' row buttons min-height:44px.
